title: Sharp Bounds for Graph Matrices
abstract: A Lean formalization of matching polynomial and logarithmic orders for the norm of every fixed finite simple graph matrix in the globally injective dense independent-sign model. For each fixed positive real moment order p, the pth norm moment to the power 1/p is bounded above and below by positive shape-dependent constants times n^((h+i0-s)/2) log(2n)^(b*/2). Here h is the number of graph roles, i0 counts isolated interior roles, s is the minimum boundary-separator size, and b* is the maximum number of attached floating components over minimum separators. The expected-norm specialization and the half-integer logarithmic exponent are also proved.
